repo:     Binkyo2013/JVHD-apk

== toolchain ==
JDK:       openjdk version "17.0.9" 2023-10-17 (Temurin 17.0.9+9)
apktool:   2.9.3 - Smali assembly of smali/ and smali_classes2/ only.
           (apktool drives its own aapt2 via a subprocess it cannot spawn in
           this sandbox, so the resource link below was run directly with the
           stock aapt2 binary - the exact one apktool 2.9.3 ships.)
aapt2:     2.19-eng.20269 (prebuilt/linux/aapt2_64 extracted from the apktool
           jar): res/ compile + link, badging verification.
framework: minimal android framework-res.apk built locally with aapt2
           (`-x` package 0x01): the 30 framework symbols this app references
           (28 attrs + color/black + style/Theme.Material.NoActionBar), every
           ID pinned with --stable-ids harvested from the previous build's
           compiled manifest/arsc and every enum/flag value cross-checked
           against the previous compiled values. It is link-time only; the
           device's real framework is used at runtime.
zipalign:  scripts/zipalign.py fallback (no Android SDK build-tools in sandbox)
apksigner: 0.9
disassembler for checks: androguard 4.1.4 (read-only verification)

== pipeline (exact commands behind this file) ==
jeremy
  java -jar apktool.jar b <staged project> -o out.apk --use-aapt2 -f
      -> classes.dex (838 classes) + classes2.dex (8) harvested from
         <stage>/build/apk/  (the later resource phase cannot spawn
         aapt2 in this sandbox; its outputs are produced below instead)
  aapt2 compile --dir res --legacy -o resources.zip
  aapt2 link -o app-base.apk -I framework-res.apk --manifest AndroidManifest.xml
      --custom-package com.JVHD.vip --java gen
      --min-sdk-version 21 --target-sdk-version 33
      --version-code 1 --version-name 1.0.6 -A assets resources.zip
  package: previous entry order; resources.arsc + lib/*.so STORED
      (apktool.yml doNotCompress), everything else DEFLATED
  python3 scripts/zipalign.py -f -p 4 unsigned.apk JVHD.apk
  apksigner sign --ks keystore/jvhd-debug.keystore --ks-pass pass:android
      --ks-key-alias jvhddebug --key-pass pass:android JVHD.apk
  apksigner verify + aapt2 dump badging + both verify scripts (all PASSED)
jeremy
scripts/build-apk.sh documents the one-command CI equivalent; the workflow
runs it as soon as the billing gate is lifted.

== what changed since the previous dist/JVHD.apk (773a44f9) ==
  applicationId       : com.bintv.launcher -> com.JVHD.vip (manifest package
                        + launcher activity com.JVHD.vip.MainActivity)
  smali               : all 46 classes moved com/bintv/launcher -> com/JVHD/vip
                        (BuildConfig.APPLICATION_ID, TizenBridge.getMyAppId)
  libbtcore.so        : JNI export Java_com_bintv_launcher_TizenBridge_n0 ->
                        Java_com_JVHD_vip_TizenBridge_n0, both ELF hash tables
                        rebuilt (scripts/patch_btcore_jni.py); the native
                        user-hash keeps working (it is fail-closed: "" would
                        lock the user gate, so this rename is mandatory)
  crash handler       : MainActivity.showStartupError rewritten - full stack
                        trace to logcat tag JVHD-CRASH, trace written to
                        getExternalFilesDir()/jvhd-crash.txt (getFilesDir()
                        fallback), exact log path + neutral message on the
                        native screen, "Thu lai" button kept, no cause named,
                        no auto-exit
  assets/tizen_shim.js: fallback appId com.bintv.launcher -> com.JVHD.vip
  scripts/workflow    : verify_apk.py classes/defaults, verify_original_manifest
                        EXPECTED_CHANGED reasons, CI badging/class greps,
                        README + docs updated to com.JVHD.vip
  unchanged           : app label JVHD Vip2, version 1.0.6 (code 1),
                        minSdk 21 / targetSdk 33, landscape, backend
                        https://jvhd-server.onrender.com, PHIM MOVIE_CONFIG_URL,
                        assets/app.js (byte-identical), res/ sources, all 12
                        PNGs (byte-identical in the APK), kotlin/, debug cert

== crash handler check (where it was verified) ==
  smali source : smali/com/JVHD/vip/MainActivity.smali showStartupError -
                 Log.getStackTraceString + Log.e(JVHD-CRASH), guarded
                 getExternalFilesDir/getFilesDir + FileWriter write/close,
                 path shown on screen, neutral strings, "Thu lai" button,
                 no finishAffinity/System.exit in MainActivity at all.
  assembled dex: androguard disassembly of Lcom/JVHD/vip/MainActivity;
                 from the shipped classes.dex - 92 instructions, all 10
                 expected strings, 1 try/catch region, the exact call list
                 above; onCreate's catch-all still routes to showStartupError.
  NOT claimed  : no crash cause is stated anywhere - the handler only
                 records the trace for a real device to provide.

== exit paths audited (no automatic self-exit) ==
  finishAffinity() + System.exit(0) exist only in
  TizenBridge.exitApp$lambda$5 <- @JavascriptInterface exitApp() <-
  tizen_shim bridge().exitApp() <- closeBinTVApplication() <-
  scanAndExitBinTV()/exitBinTV() <- exit-dialog buttons <- showExitModal()
  <- handleBackKey(). Both closeBinTVApplication() call sites sit in the
  exit-dialog handlers; no timer, no /config failure path, no startup path
  and no exception path reaches them. Leaving the app is always explicit.
  BACK on the startup-error screen calls plain finish() (user pressed it).
  No onReceivedError/onRenderProcessGone/process-kill hooks exist.

== NOT verified (no physical Android device available) ==
  - real cold-start behaviour against https://jvhd-server.onrender.com
  - the native crash screen rendering + jvhd-crash.txt on a real device
  - the renamed JNI export resolving on a real ART runtime (verified only
    by ELF hash simulation, not by dlopen)
  - remote-control focus traversal on the native error screen
